sar.narrative: On or about 2016-12-29, suspicious transaction activity totaling $55.89 was detected on card C08106-K1 associated with customer C08106. Flagged transaction 3583227 exhibited patterns consistent with card testing. Analysis of graph linkages identified connections to 5 additional card accounts sharing common digital identifiers. Verification confirmed unauthorized use, indicating compromise of account credentials. The financial institution has blocked the impacted payment instruments and instituted monitoring on linked entities.
